projects.title: Automated Portable Nebulization System (APN)
projects.overview: An innovative portable nebulizer that continuously monitors patient pulse signals in real-time and automatically adapts medication dosage delivery over Wi-Fi.
projects.problem_solved: Conventional nebulizers deliver a fixed medication rate regardless of the patient's respiratory urgency or heart rate vitals, which can lead to suboptimal therapeutic delivery or over-medication. APN personalizes drug aerosol delivery dynamically.
key_features: Real-time pulse and heart rate monitoring through integrated optical pulse sensor
Adaptive dosage calculation algorithm adjusting ultrasonic/mesh nebulizer actuator frequency
Wi-Fi enabled tele-health dashboard allowing remote doctor/caregiver monitoring
Compact, lightweight, battery-operated portable design for asthmatic and COPD patients
projects.achievement: Awarded 3rd Place in the Prestigious ISTI-Sponsored National-Level Project Contest (Pulse-Based Automated Portable Nebulizer).

projects.title: ML-Based Smart e-Public Distribution System (Smart e-PDS)
projects.category: AI / Machine Learning & Full Stack Web Platform
projects.overview: A next-generation Public Distribution System that eliminates ration shop leakage, phantom beneficiaries, and long wait times using AI/ML facial recognition, crowd monitoring, and seamless digital payments.
projects.problem_solved: Traditional ration distribution suffers from fraudulent withdrawals, identity spoofing, proxy ration collection, and hours-long queue congestion, especially for senior citizens and differently-abled individuals.
key_features: Biometric AI Facial Recognition and OTP two-factor authentication to ensure rations reach genuine beneficiaries
Smart Card integration with real-time monthly ration quota calculation and digital stock transparency
Real-time queue monitoring utilizing AI crowd detection computer vision to display live queue status to citizens
Online monthly ration pre-selection, digital UPI payment gateway, and instant automated digital invoice generation
Voice-enabled multimodal AI assistant designed for accessibility in local languages (Tamil & English)
projects.publication: Published in IEEE Xplore: 'ML based Smart e - Public Distribution System' (DOI/URL: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11382690, Date: November 2025).

projects.title: ML Based Fruit Health and Quality Analysis System
projects.category: Computer Vision, Spectral Analysis & AI Research
projects.overview: A novel Multi-Modal Convolutional Neural Network (MMCNN) system combining high-resolution visual RGB images and spectral data to grade fruit quality, detect internal/external diseases, and measure chemical properties.
key_features: Extracts fine-grained spatial features from visual RGB images using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
Reduces high-dimensional spectral data using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to correlate with internal chemical indicators (sugar levels, moisture content, acidity)
Fuses spatial and spectral feature vectors into a unified multi-modal representation
Optimizes deep neural network hyperparameters using a Genetic Algorithm (GA), achieving superior classification accuracy, high precision, and drastically lower false predictions
projects.impact: Empowers agricultural exporters, farmers, and automated sorting packhouses to non-destructively grade produce, maximize export revenue, and curb post-harvest losses.
projects.publication: Published in IEEE Xplore: 'ML Based Fruit Health and Quality Analysis System' (DOI/URL: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11012639, Date: June 2025).
